tips.text: Bring a punch-through or beam weapon such as Ignis, Glaxion Vandal, Gaze or a glaive for the spinning-target lights.
Farm Kela for Saryn and Twin Kohmak at once; the Saryn parts pay at mission end and the blueprint drops on her death.
Stand on the wall left of the exit door to dodge orbital strikes; no other wall works.
Learn the pad and green-light puzzle before queueing; pub squads often stand in the pad room waiting for something to happen.
Skip Viral builds; she is immune to Viral procs and cannot be staggered.
Use Mesa or high-status weapons to make the damage phases trivial.
Check that every squadmate has 25 Judgement Points before queueing; a pub partner without them blocks the run.
Abort if the fight will not progress; failing costs no Judgement Points.
Build the Detonite Injectors and both Kohmaks first so their timers run while you farm Kela.
Take Grineer Invasion rewards for Detonite Injectors; each pays 3 and skips the Ampule grind.
Time the Twin Kohmak build with Plague Star, which pays built Forma toward the 3-Forma bill.
Expect one polarity and poor ammo economy despite the 3-Forma cost.
Save your Detonite Injectors; many Chem Lab weapons use them.
The drop draws little complaint; the grumbling is about Kela's fight and the 3 Forma for one polarity.
